newsitem.title: FRANCE: Rouen flour exports steady in December, up in 1996.
newsitem.headline: Rouen flour exports steady in December, up in 1996.

text.p: Soft wheat flour exports from Rouen, northern France, totalled 42,210 tonnes in December, barely changed from 43,000 tonnes in December 1995, port officials said on Tuesday.
Annual exports were up at 774,000 tonnes for 1996, compared with 690,000 tonnes in 1995, provisional port figures showed.
Last month's exports included 20,419 tonnes for Yemen, 13,510 tonnes for west Africa, 5,531 tonnes for Libya and 2,750 tonnes for Lithuania.
